lines.zh: 我踏过无名之地，土在脚下裂。
lines.en: I cross the Nameless Land and the earth splits.

lines.zh: 我的翼展遮住了这一片天。
lines.en: My wingspan blots out this patch of sky.

lines.zh: 我每一步都比上一次沉。
lines.en: Each step lands heavier than the last.
The mountain opens a gap before me.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在灰雾里发暗光。
lines.en: My scales glow dully in the ash.

lines.zh: 我拖着长尾，扫平一片林子。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a stand of trees flat.
My scales scrape along the cliff wall.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，连风都停了。
lines.en: Where I pass, even the wind stops.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，脚陷进岩层。
lines.en: I settle and my feet sink through stone.
I walk toward the center of the field.
I crouch, my back rising and falling.
I coil my tail beneath me.
Ash drifts into my eyes.
I open my mouth and black smoke seeps out.
Judgment needs no words.
The ground warms beneath me.
My claws sink into the soil.
I am considering the method.
The sky feels low because I am here.
I hear the far mountains rumbling.
Ash settles on my scales.
The wind goes around me.

lines.zh: 我的尾尖敲了一下地面。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the ground once.
I lift my head to the light.
I smell the fear on you.
My wingtips brush the ground.
I lean down; my shadow holds you.
You stand there like a fleck of ash.

lines.zh: 我的名字是克拉里加提欧。
lines.en: My name is Clarigatio.
Have you read the name on the stone?
The judgment begins.
I'll remember that face.
You do not flinch; that is rare.
I heard you coming from far away.
I look at you the way I'd look at a stone.

lines.zh: 你手里的武器不足以对付我。
lines.en: The weapon in your hand is not enough.
Your grip never settles.
Say something.
My blood falls into the ash.
A scale comes loose.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地塌了一块。
lines.en: I give half a step and the ground falls away.
I will remember that pain.
My eyes narrow.
I brace myself more firmly.
Blood drips onto stone and smokes.
I lower myself again.
You managed that.

lines.zh: 我的鳞上多了一道白痕
lines.en: A pale scar now runs across my scales.
My hunger doesn't sit in my stomach.
For whom do you hold that up?

lines.zh: 我的牙齿不是为这个长的。
lines.en: My teeth did not grow for that.
Don't hold it in front of my eyes.
I lower my head and sniff.
That will not appease anything.
The smell clings to your hands.
I close my mouth.
It only makes me want to strike.
Do not use that to stall.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，被弹开很远。
lines.en: You hit me and are thrown far.
I do not even turn my head.
You hit me like hitting a cliff.
You land at my feet.
I lift a foot; you should move.
My wing sweeps over you.
The impact leaves your ears ringing.
I shift half a step aside.
The ground cracks under us.
You didn't even scratch a scale.
There is no second one in this world.
The other is elsewhere.
We do not share the same ground.
I stand beside Witherzilla.
He does not come, and I do not go.
Only I hold the Nameless Land.
I look up at the light.
I'm the only one in this sky.
My shadow drags along the ridge.
I settle down again.
I lower my head and take it up.
Too small for me to even grip.
I roll it between my claws.
What falls here is mine.
I flick it away with a claw.
I squeezed, and it split.

lines.zh: 我用爪子挖开土，把它取出来。
lines.en: I dig it out of the soil.
This spoil is nothing.
I tuck it between my scales.
You dropped it; I will hold it.
You have stepped into my field.
I have done this a long time.
My judgment begins.
I lift my head and the clouds part.

lines.zh: 你还有最后一句话的时间。
lines.en: You have time for one last sentence.
My claws drive into the ground.
This place will be emptied.
There will be no second chance.
That's all the tricks you have.
Come.
I do not announce; I execute.
Dust leaps up around my feet.
This is the last time I speak.
You have soiled this place.
It is time to finish.
My shadow falls over your head.
Even the ash stops drifting.
Your name need not remain.
I raise a foreclaw.
The verdict is already cut in stone.
Light falls with every step I take.
The ground sinks where I step.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀展开，天就暗了。
lines.en: My wings open and the sky darkens.
There is nowhere you can retreat.
I lift my head and light falls.
My claws part the air.
You are breathing fast.

lines.zh: 你的每一次呼吸我都数着
lines.en: I count every breath you take.
This ground is already mine.

lines.zh: 我一爪落下，地上多了沟。
lines.en: My claw falls and leaves a trench.
You hide behind a stone.
Stone will not stop judgment.
My tail sweeps in.
Your weapon is rattling.
The light is closer now.
This whole sky lies under my eyes.

lines.zh: 你拐进哪条路我都知道
lines.en: I know every turn you take.
I wait for you to fall.
The time has come.
My claw tip lines up with your head.

lines.zh: 我的爪子劈下来，地裂成两半。
lines.en: My claw comes down and the ground splits.
My tail breaks a pillar of stone.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬合，你听见雷声。
lines.en: My teeth close and you hear thunder.
My charge throws you far.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扫过，风把你按倒。
lines.en: My wing sweeps and the wind flattens you.
I put no force behind that claw.
The ground is smashed into a pit.

lines.zh: 你挡住了，可你退了十步。
lines.en: You blocked it and fell back ten steps.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划开你的护甲。
lines.en: My claws tear your armor open.
You have not found your feet.
My blood is hot too.
Your bones haven't broken yet.
That one, I meant.
Don't stop - get up.

lines.zh: 无名之地的天裂了一道。
lines.en: A rift opens over the Nameless Land.

lines.zh: 我落下来时，整片地都塌了。
lines.en: The whole ground collapses as I land.
I am called Clarigatio.
Ash shakes from my wings.
I walk out of the clouds.

lines.zh: 我落地，四周的石头都立起来。
lines.en: I land and the stones around stand on end.
The air grows thin.
The light falls upon my back.
One step, and the ridge caves in.
I open my eyes, and the sky lights up.
The clouds split and I come down.
This fight will be hard.

lines.zh: 我的名字刻在石上，现在石碎了。
lines.en: My name was cut in stone; the stone is broken now.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼睛，看见世界在退。
lines.en: I open my eyes and see the world recede.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气把灰吹散。
lines.en: My first breath blows the ash away.

lines.zh: 我从一条缝里挤进这个世界。
lines.en: I squeeze into this world through a seam.

lines.zh: 我落地时，远处鸟群全坠了。
lines.en: When I land, distant flocks fall from the sky.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，一切都变小了。
lines.en: I lift my head and everything grows small.

lines.zh: 我站直身子，云从我肩上滑落。
lines.en: I stand tall and clouds slide off my shoulders.
This is the place I am to judge.

lines.zh: 火绕着我烧，我却更冷了。
lines.en: Fire burns around me and I only grow colder.

lines.zh: 我从高空坠下，砸穿了地面。
lines.en: I fall from the sky and punch through the ground.

lines.zh: 水吞不掉我，它只是沸腾了。
lines.en: Water cannot swallow me; it only boils.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀开我的鳞，我吼了一声。
lines.en: The blast peels my scales and I roar.
The arrow sticks to a scale, not through it.

lines.zh: 咒光在我身上劈啪作响。
lines.en: Spell-light crackles across me.
I have been hungry long; it does not matter.

lines.zh: 雷落在我的角上，我接住了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my horn and I take it.

lines.zh: 虚空在我脚下，我仍站着。
lines.en: The void is under my feet and I still stand.
